label: Qotom Q555G6 6-LAN mini PC
description: Fanless 6-LAN industrial mini PC on an Intel i5-7200U (Skylake-U) with six Intel I210/I211 gigabit RJ45 ports and no wireless.
notes: 6x 1G (not 2.5G): Qotom's 2.5G six-port boxes are separate SKUs (e.g. i225-V 4305U models). Also sold in 1U rack ears - modelled as a host/mini-PC since the board is the desktop unit. Sibling Q750G5 (5x 2.5G) is already in the catalogue.
